**Starts** once #270 is merged.

## Why

The first trip played by both harnesses on a new trip file. This issue is the Claude Code run. #276 is the Codex run of the same trip and persona, so the two sessions differ only in the simulated user. The Moab trip has what the San Francisco trip doesn't, such as a three-night stay with a rest day (domain model 5.2). It's played with the `curt` persona, the furthest from `easygoing`. It adds to the corpus that agent evaluations (#53) score: 8 simulated trips, from two harnesses and four personas, plus the trips Joe and his wife planned. Agreed in chat on 2026-11-04.

The final itinerary isn't checked against an expected one. Live places and the workers' picks change from run to run, so two good runs can end with different hotels.

## Design

- [Simulated users README](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/simulated-users/README.md): how to set up, start, and check a run.
- `simulated-users/trips/moab.md`, written in #270 from domain model section 5.2, and `simulated-users/personas/curt.md`.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/domain-model.md), section 5.2: the Moab trip.

## Open questions

None.

## Do

- Run `trips/moab.md` with the `curt` persona on the live site (`https://roadtrip.jjk3.com`), with Claude Code and Sonnet, as `claude-code-sonnet`. Set it up and start it as the README's "Set up a run" and "Start a harness" say. Don't run it at the same time as another simulated user.
- Check each session as the README's "Check a run" says. Mark a failed run in Phoenix, as it says.
- If a session fails a check because of the setup, fix the setup, the trip file, the persona file, or the instructions, and run again.
- File each app bug the run finds as a new issue, as "Check a run" says. Don't fix it here.
- If #276's results comment is in, note how the two harnesses played the user differently, such as how many facts each gave at once, or how each handled the changes. If it isn't in yet, #276 does this instead.

## Done when

- A simulated session of the Moab trip, played by Claude Code, is in the `road-trip-agent` Phoenix project, and passes the checks.
- The results are in a comment on this issue, with the differences between the harnesses if this run is the second. The app bugs found are filed.

## Ends in

A results comment on this issue, as the README's "Check a run" says. A PR only if the setup, the trip file, the persona file, or the instructions change.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

**Starts** once #67 is merged.

## Why

The second trip recorded for the corpus, and the first played by more than one harness and model. The Moab trip has what the San Francisco trip doesn't, such as a three-night stay with a rest day (domain model 5.2). Two or three harness and model pairs play the same trip file with the same persona file, so agent evaluations (#53) get sessions where only the simulated user differs, and we see how much the pairs differ.

As in #67, the final itinerary isn't checked against the domain model's example, since live places and workers' picks change from run to run.

## Design

- [Simulated users README](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/simulated-users/README.md): how to add a harness, write a trip file, and set up, start, and check a run. Its part "What Joe does" covers adding a bot user. Its sections "Check a new harness", "Add a trip or a persona", "Start a harness", and "Check a run" cover this issue.
- [The simulated user](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/issues/66): `simulated-users/trips/san-francisco.md`, the example trip file.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/domain-model.md), section 5.2: the Moab trip.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Write the Moab trip file, from domain model section 5.2, with changes partway through. The Moab changes in `reviews/walkthroughs/prompt-6.md`, section "Changes to make along the way", are a starting point. That prompt is out of date, so check each change still fits the current design. The trip is planned in one session. A change may start a new session right away, but never on a later day, so leave out changes such as the user returning the next day, or opening the trip again on October 6, 2027. Joe decided on 2026-11-04, in chat, that coming back to a trip later isn't tested here. The forecast offer the dated steps were for is #259.
  - Write it as the README's "Add a trip or a persona" says. Each change is something the user does, or a reaction to what the coordinator says, since live data can't be counted on. Example: the old step 3 counts on the opening-hours check flagging Fisher Towers, Delicate Arch, Milt's, and Gifford Homestead. Write it instead as what the user does if the planner says a place is closed, or is closed when they'd get there.
  - The old step 7, the user returning the next day, becomes a new session right after the other changes. It asks "why did we pick that Moab hotel?" and "what's left to decide?" Leave out steps 8 and 9.
- Run it with two or three harness and model pairs on the live site, each signed in as its own bot user, with the `easygoing` persona. Joe adds any new harness first, as the README's "What Joe does" says. Then check the harness before its first full run, as "Check a new harness" says, and add its bot user to `bot-users.md`. Run the pairs one after another, not at the same time, as "Start a harness" says.
- Check each session as the README's "Check a run" says. Mark a failed run in Phoenix, as it says.
- Note how the pairs played the user differently, such as how many facts each gave at once, or how it handled the planned changes.
- File each app bug the runs find as a new issue. Don't fix it here.

## Done when

- A simulated session of the Moab trip from each pair is in the `road-trip-agent` Phoenix project.
- Each simulated session passes the checks, and the results and the differences between the pairs are in the PR.
- The app bugs found are filed as issues.

## Ends in

A PR, with the Moab trip file.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
